_source: Fallback for build/alchemy-usage.ts, used only when packages/alchemy/package.json on alchemy-run/alchemy@main cannot be fetched at build time. Lists the @distilled.cloud/* packages Alchemy depends on. Refresh with: curl -s https://raw.githubusercontent.com/alchemy-run/alchemy/main/packages/alchemy/package.json | jq -r '.dependencies | keys[] | select(startswith("@distilled.cloud/")) | ltrimstr("@distilled.cloud/")'
